data.define: Used when the best choice is obvious and needs no thought.

misuse.text: Don't call a hard decision 'a no-brainer'.
misuse.why: It dismisses the other person's worries.

publish.title: What does "it's a no-brainer" mean?
publish.value: It's a no-brainer = The choice is very easy. Example: "Free tickets? It's a no-brainer!" (casual English).
